author: SomeOrdinaryGamers
description:
Hello guys and gals, it's me Mutahar again! This time we take a look at the rapid progress of PS5 emulation. Just a month ago we saw these emulators barely reaching the title screens of games and now we're able to run GTA 5 at up to 60fps in it's early stages. This is really good progress that could end up preserving Playstation and GTA regardless of how Sony or any company feels. How? Let's find out! Thanks for watching!
Like, Comment and Subscribe for more videos!
title: We Might Be Emulating GTA 6 On PC...
